note: Which template-specification families govern each report type (services.regspec.families_for). A filing freezes the governing version of every family listed for its report type. A report type absent here has no specification on the route yet.

previous_period.note: Report types whose governing templates print the previous disclosure reference date (T-1): the filing embeds the previous period's frozen book for the same scope when it is frozen, so the T-1 columns are rebuilt from the filing alone.
